saw_lines: Clothing shoppers buy for one occasion, then return for the next. They want to see the piece worn before they commit.
So the sale is won in the first frame, where a buyer decides whether an outfit fits her occasion or keeps scrolling.
Your 22 ads carry no proof number, so new buyers have nothing to trust. Add one real figure, like your review count, to the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 31 Oct 2026
points: None of your 22 ads carries a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing to trust before the click. Pick one real figure, like your review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it on the creative.
None of your 22 ads mentions an offer or discount, so a new buyer has no reason to order today. Put one first order offer or a small bundle in the opening line of three new ads and say it plainly.

Your 22 ads open with 18 different stories, and the biggest leads only 2. Each new story has to prove itself again from zero. Pick the two best stories and build the next batch from them, with three variations each.
13 of your 22 ads have run 60 days or more, so they already hold up. Build three more variations of your oldest winner, each with a new opening line and a different photo or clip.

ads_1: First order offer creative built on your two best stories
